items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I sat in and what's his name, the guy's in the movies now or was. He was a drummer.

ctx.x: You asked me what I was doing during the summer, if I can go back. During the -- one of these bands that came to
play a house party, I sat in and what's his name, the guy's in the movies now or was. He was a drummer. A real clown. He's a comedian and he used to do a lot of things, but he was in the band.
